name: B2Bware Default
author: B2Bware
description: Reference storefront theme bundled with every B2Bware store. Use it as the starting point for your own theme.
_slots_note: Informational only — slots are discovered by scanning @storefrontSlot('key'[, config]) in the Blade files, and that scan is the source of truth. Optional second-argument config objects declare slot context for the Theme Editor (e.g. ['context' => ['product' => 'product']]). 'content-top' / 'content-bottom' are the standard owner-editable regions on every page; 'hero' renders full-width above the breadcrumbs via the layout's @yield('hero').
_slots_omitted_note: 'error' and 'not-found' are intentionally slot-free: they render outside the normal middleware stack (and 'error' may render while the slot store itself is failing), so resolving owner content there could turn a handled error into a second one.
